Výsledky sú aktualizované v reálnom čase pre jednotlivé úseky, tímy a celkové poradie tímov v cieli.

Taktiež je možné jednoduchou formou cez aplikáciu spravovať zoznam všetkých úsekov a členov tímu na nich priradených, zmeniť zraneného bežca na vybranom úseku odoslaním sms správy organizátorovi.

With THEMAGIC5 app it is now possible to purchase a pair of custom fitted swimming goggles. The app in-cludes an innovative scanning technology, which is easy to use and enables the company to produce gog-gles that are fitted to your facial structure. Follow these 3 simple steps and your first ever custom fitted swimming goggles will be on their way to your mailbox!
 
3-step process:
- Download the app
- Scan yourself and select your preferred color/mirror coating
- Enter shipment and payment details*
 
Main features in the app
Scanning Technology:
The scanning technology is proprietary and is developed with the purpose of securing an optimal fit of your goggles. This will minimize discomfort and prevent water leakage. The scan is easy to complete and typically takes less than a minute. See the scanning introduction videos in the app and follow these instructions when you do the scan:
 
- Access to high-speed internet, preferably Wi-Fi
- Check that you have constant light exposure
- Have your back against an even surface (e.g. a wall or a door)
 
Manage your orders:
If you have already bought your goggles via our website, you can login to the app and your account will automatically have a voucher equal to your purchase. All you have to do is complete the scan and select your color/mirror option.
 
If you have not yet bought your goggles, you can purchase them goggles directly in the app. Simply follow the 3-step process described at the top.
 
Reorder goggles from your purchase history. We will register your previous purchases in your app. This way it is easy to reorder your favorites. You can also reorder for your family members if they have used your ac-count to do their scan.
 
Find your favorite goggles:
In the app you can browse through our product catalogue to find your favorite goggles. You can see non-mirror and mirror coating to find out what best suits your needs.
 
 
*You will not have to add in your payment details if you have already bought your goggles via our website.

With myMondraker you will be able to access all the news of the Mondraker Universe, register your Mondraker bikes, connect them to your mobile phone through the MIND system and enjoy all its telemetry and tracking features in real time, among other functions. You will also be able to get immediate information about news of the brand, news, events, Demo test, etc.

And if your bike features MIND system you will have access to:

Mondraker bike suspension telemetry and GPS tracking of your rides.
Perfectly calibrate your suspension, analyze its performance and record the main data of your rides. myMondraker allows you to connect your Mondraker bike's MIND to your smartphone and make a perfect adjustment of the SAG and suspension setup, suited to your riding style and your riding skills. In addition, you can record your riding sessions with a GPS tracker and monitor the most important data of your riding activity, without having to carry your mobile phone with you. 

Adjust your suspension and get the most out of your Mondraker bike with MIND
Customize the SAG settings and setup of your Mondraker bike in two easy steps. Tune the suspension according to your weight and riding mode and extract the maximum potential from your bike. Whether it is for long rides, jumps, descents or cross country riding, you will always have your bike's suspension dialed to get the best out of you as a rider.

Registrar tus salidas ciclistas y medir tus progresos
Log on and record your activities in manual or automatic mode, without having to carry your mobile phone with you, thanks to the integrated GPS on your Mondraker bike with MIND. Check the key parameters of the suspension performance: jumps, bottom-outs and suspension travel at any moment of your ride. In addition you will have the statistics of your times, speed and all the information that helps you to know and improve as a rider. Share your progress thanks to the connection with Strava and Facebook.

Activate the anti-theft system.
With myMondraker you will be able to manage your incidents or activate the anti-theft alarm.

Enjoy all the features of the app designed exclusively for Mondraker bike riders:

- Direct Bluetooth connection with the bike's MIND for adjustments, activity logging and data transfer.
- Guide to adjust SAG for front and rear suspension according to rider weight and riding style on Mondraker bike models featuring MIND.
- Activity record for Mondraker bikes featuring MIND in manual, semi-automatic or automatic modes without the need to carry a cellphone on the ride.
- All data and graphs to monitor the rides: number of jumps, front and rear suspension travel, bottom outs, track, distance, time, altitude, average speed for models featuring MIND.
- Times, speeds, jumps, etc stats of the activities performed with Mondraker bikes featuring MIND.
- Connectivity with Strava and Facebook to share the activities.
- Anti-theft alarm system on Mondraker bikes featuring MIND.
- All Mondraker bike characteristics information.
- Direct contact line with Mondraker SAT department for managing warranty and any issue. 
- Direct management of bike-thefts.
- All Mondraker related exclusive news and information.

Track your Dart Games, view Statistics, Create Tournaments and Play Online against other players. All for free and automatically synchronized across all platforms.

TRACK DARTS GAMES
Track your darts games in the scoreboard in 6+ different game modes. Currently there is an extensive X01 game mode, as well as Cricket, Around the Clock, Shanghai, Elimination and Highscore. More game modes will be added all the time. For each game mode you have configuration options.
You can also customize the scoreboard, for example, you can choose the input method between "Whole round" and "Each dart individually".

VIEW STATISTICS
View extensive statistics about your dart games. There are many statistics for all game modes, which you can view both as a table and as a graph. In order not to lose the overview you can choose which statistics you want to see and which not.

ORGANIZE TOURNAMENTS
In tournament mode you can organize a league or knockout tournament with many people. A tournament schedule with a game list is automatically calculated and you can play the games one after the other. At any time you can see the current standings or who made it to the finals.

PLAY ONLINE AGAINST OTHERS
In the revamped online section, you can add your friends in the friends system and invite them to online matches. In addition, you can also create open lobbies and search for an opponent in the chat.
You can chat in the online area itself, in the lobby as well as during and after the game.
In the lobby and in the profiles of your opponents, you can see their abandonment rate and their usual average to decide if you want to enter the match.

SYNCHRONIZED ACROSS ALL PLATFORMS
Pro Darts is available on all platforms. If you use cloud players, your data is automatically synchronized on all your devices. So you won't lose stats and you'll be up to date on every device.

COMPETE AGAINST COMPUTERS
If you don't have a real opponent with you, you can train against computer opponents. Ten different difficulty levels are available. You can also add computer opponents in tournaments.
